name: boilerplate_solidjs
author: Éverton Toffanetto
description: A SolidJS boilerplate with TypeScript, Vite+, server-side rendering, and automated testing.

scripts.typecheck: vp run i18n:generate && vp run typecheck-app && vp run typecheck-node
scripts.typecheck:node: vp run i18n:generate && vp run typecheck-node
scripts.lint: vp run i18n:generate && vp run lint-project
scripts.check:ci: vp run i18n:generate && vp run check-project
scripts.test: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run
scripts.test:ci: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run --bail=1 --coverage
scripts.test:coverage: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run --coverage
scripts.test:unit: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run --project node --project dom
scripts.test:watch: vp run i18n:generate && vp test watch
scripts.test:shuffle: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run --sequence.shuffle
scripts.test:browser: vp run i18n:generate && vp test run --project browser
scripts.bun:update: vp env pin bun@latest && vp install
scripts.dead-code: vp run i18n:generate && vp run dead-code-project
scripts.scan:secrets: kingfisher scan . --git-history none --no-validate --redact --exclude node_modules --exclude dist --exclude dist-ssr --exclude .nitro --exclude .output --exclude .vercel --exclude .tsbuild --exclude playwright-report --exclude test-results --exclude coverage --exclude .vitest
scripts.validate: vp run check:ci && vp run typecheck:node && vp run test:coverage && vp run test:tooling && vp run build
